name: vgl
description: Lightweight virtual globe library: streams baked elevation and imagery packs and draws the globe through OpenGL / OpenGL ES, Direct3D 11 or Ogre, behind a C API.

defaults.description: The defaults module (vgl::defaults): a thread pool, a file reader and a disk cache

http.description: An HTTP reader in the defaults module, on libcurl

ogre.description: The Ogre 14 backend (vgl::ogre), a static library
